# Annachi Murukku Shop

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Annachi Murukku Shop?
73/7, Nerkundram Pathai (100 Feet Road), Vadapalani, Chennai 600 026 (Ambika Empire Hotel & HDFC Bank signal, left side).

### What facilities does Annachi Murukku Shop have?
Kai murukku, Rice murukku, Magizhampoo murukku, Thenkuzhal murukku, Thattai, Karam mixture, Karasev, Athirasam (ghee), Somas, Rava laddu, Porivilangai urundai, Halwa, Kadalai mittai, Coconut items, Village items, Chips.

### Do you have other branches?
No. We have no branches — only our shop on 100 Feet Road, Vadapalani.

### How are the sweets packed?
In air-tight containers and corrugated boxes, so they are protected and stay fresh.

### How do I order from Annachi Murukku Shop?
Pick a date in the order section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 94443 82651.
